Why do these need to come from the EM config?  Don't we know that based on querying the device?

Yes, we can query the device for it. But failure in getting response from the device for that command could bring down all PCIe Port Telemetries. This would be fixed for a platform anyway and hence the use of EM config. I can also make it dynamic by querying the device for this info if you prefer that.

Why do we beed ActiveWidth here and LanesInUse in the PCIeDevice?

The ActiveWidth here are for each port (upstream as well as downstream). LaneInUse in PCIeDevice are for the port that gets connected to the Host. Value of LanesInUse in the PCIeDevice will be identical to ActiveWidth of UP_0 port for ConnectX devices.

How can we make sure that this gets tested in the future?

I think it should be double as corresponding redfish property `CurrentSpeedGbps` is also double. I have left a comment for it on the pdi patch.

> How can we make sure that this gets tested in the future?

While testing we can manually check and ensure the alignment with the PDI. Since both dbus-sensors and bmcweb reviews refer to the pdi patch for data type of each property, any mismatch can get caught during reviews at either places.
